## Appearance

Tessa Carrow has red, curly hair. She also features hazel eyes, which she sometimes shuts tightly in a crinkled fashion.

## History

Tessa Carrow is the youngest among the [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere) children, a plump six-year-old child. While tasked with delivering a basket of strawberries to the manse, she was harassed and chased through the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) street with a dried codfish by [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md). A terrified Tessa was rescued by Miss Winifred, who then returned her home.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P19](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0019)_
